bg_atcButtonNotFound.description: Short internal failure reason recorded when a product's Add to Cart button couldn't be found or clicked.

bg_ageEarlierToday.description: Relative-age fragment for a previously recorded upsell choice made less than an hour ago.

bg_ageRecently.description: Relative-age fragment for a previously recorded upsell choice made within the last day.

bg_ageFromBefore.description: Relative-age fragment for a previously recorded upsell choice older than a day.

bg_noCoverage.description: Description of a previously recorded upsell choice where the user declined protection-plan coverage.

bg_selectedOption.description: Generic fallback description of a previously recorded upsell choice when the specific option label isn't available.

bg_applyingChoiceAge.description: Operation-status detail when auto-replaying a previously recorded upsell choice. $1 is an already-formatted relative-age phrase (bg_ageEarlierToday etc.), $2 is a quoted choice description.

bg_applyingSavedChoice.description: On-page toast when auto-replaying a previously recorded upsell choice. $1 is a quoted choice description.

bg_cartRestoredPartial.description: Final summary toast after a per-item restore with some failures. $1 added count, $2 total count, $3 failed count (all plain numbers).

bg_cartRestoredAll.description: Final summary toast after a fully successful per-item restore. $1 is an already-formatted 'N item(s)' phrase.

bg_addingWishlistToCart.description: Operation-status title while bulk-adding a wishlist's items to the live Amazon cart.

bg_addingItemsFromListPage.description: Operation-status detail while adding items via the list page's native Add-to-Cart buttons. $1 is an already-formatted 'N item(s)' phrase.

bg_addingItemsFromList.description: On-page toast while adding items via the list page. $1 is an already-formatted 'N item(s)' phrase.

bg_addedItemsToCart.description: Success toast after items are added to the live Amazon cart. $1 is an already-formatted 'N item(s)' phrase.

bg_couldNotSaveCart.description: Fallback error when saving a cart to a new Amazon list fails without a more specific reason.

bg_couldntSaveLeftUntouched.description: Operation-status title when a save fails, so the clear step is correctly skipped. $1 is a more specific error reason.

bg_couldntSaveCartTitle.description: Title of the on-page toast when saving a cart fails.

bg_cartLeftAsIs.message: Your Amazon cart was left as-is. $1
bg_cartLeftAsIs.description: Detail of the on-page toast when saving a cart fails — reassures the user nothing was lost. $1 is a more specific error reason.

bg_savedNOfTotal.description: Fragment summarizing a partially-successful save, e.g. 'Saved 8/10 items'. $1 and $2 are plain numbers.

bg_savedNItems.description: Fragment summarizing a fully successful save. $1 is an already-formatted 'N item(s)' phrase.

bg_savedNoteToCartUntouched.description: Operation-status title after a save-only (no clear) completes. $1 is an already-formatted save summary (bg_savedNOfTotal or bg_savedNItems), $2 is the cart name.

bg_cartSavedForLater.description: Title of the on-page toast after a save-only (no clear) completes successfully.

bg_savedNoteToCartUntouchedDetail.message: $1 to "$2". Your Amazon cart is untouched.
bg_savedNoteToCartUntouchedDetail.description: Detail of the on-page toast after a save-only completes. $1 is an already-formatted save summary, $2 is the cart name.

bg_savedNoteNowClearing.description: Operation-status detail for the Save & Clear flow, once the save finished and the clear step begins. $1 is an already-formatted save summary.

bg_savedAndCleared.description: Title of the on-page toast when a Save & Clear completes fully.

bg_savedNoteToCartEmpty.message: $1 to "$2". Your Amazon cart is empty.
bg_savedNoteToCartEmpty.description: Detail of the on-page toast when a Save & Clear completes fully. $1 is an already-formatted save summary, $2 is the cart name.

bg_savedButCouldntClear.description: Title of the on-page toast when the save half of Save & Clear succeeds but the clear half fails.

bg_savedNoteCouldntClear.message: $1 to "$2", but your Amazon cart couldn't be cleared. Try Clear Amazon cart again.
bg_savedNoteCouldntClear.description: Detail of the on-page toast when the clear half of Save & Clear fails. $1 is an already-formatted save summary, $2 is the cart name.

bg_amazonNeedsFormatChoice.description: Operation-status title when a saved item's edition is uncartable and the user must pick another format.

bg_chooseCartableFormat.message: Choose a cartable format for "$1" to continue adding the rest.
bg_chooseCartableFormat.description: Operation-status detail asking the user to pick another format. $1 is a shortened item title.

bg_chooseFormatOnAmazon.description: Title of the on-page prompt dialog asking the user to pick another format.

bg_savedFormatCannotBeAdded.message: The saved format of "$1" cannot be added to the cart. Choose another format or edition on this page that offers Add to Cart. Styx will resume automatically.
bg_savedFormatCannotBeAdded.description: Body of the on-page prompt dialog asking the user to pick another format. $1 is a shortened item title.

bg_choiceChooseFormat.description: Primary button label on the format-choice prompt.

bg_choiceSkipThisItem.description: Secondary button label on the format-choice prompt.

bg_couldNotShowFormatPrompt.message: Could not show the format picker prompt
bg_couldNotShowFormatPrompt.description: Internal error reason when the format-choice prompt can't be injected into the page.

bg_skippedFormatUnavailable.message: Skipped because the saved format is unavailable
bg_skippedFormatUnavailable.description: Reason recorded when the user chooses to skip an item rather than pick a new format.

bg_chooseFormatShowsAtc.message: Choose a format for "$1" that shows Add to Cart — Styx will resume automatically
bg_chooseFormatShowsAtc.description: On-page toast after the user chooses to pick a new format, prompting them to find one with a working Add to Cart. $1 is a shortened item title.

bg_amazonTabWasClosed.description: Error reason when the Amazon tab closes while waiting for a format choice.

bg_selectedFormatUnavailable.description: Error reason when the newly selected format also turns out to be unavailable.

bg_noFormatSelectedTimeout.message: No cartable format was selected within 10 minutes
bg_noFormatSelectedTimeout.description: Error reason when the user doesn't pick a format within the time limit.

bg_savedFormatUnavailableChooseAnother.message: The saved format is unavailable; choose another format
bg_savedFormatUnavailableChooseAnother.description: Reason returned by the product-availability classifier when a book/media item's saved edition has alternate purchasable formats. Used to decide whether to pause and prompt the user.

bg_pageNoLongerExists.description: Reason returned by the product-availability classifier when Amazon shows a 404/removed-page state.

bg_productCurrentlyUnavailable.description: Fallback reason returned by the product-availability classifier when Amazon's own availability text couldn't be read.

bg_waitingOnYourChoice.description: Operation-status title while waiting for the user to resolve a protection-plan/warranty upsell.

bg_pickProtectionOption.message: Pick a protection option for "$1" on the Amazon page — restore resumes automatically.
bg_pickProtectionOption.description: Operation-status detail while waiting on an upsell choice. $1 is a shortened item title.

bg_amazonNeedsProtectionPlanChoice.message: Amazon needs your protection-plan choice for "$1". Pick an option below — Styx will keep restoring the rest of your cart as soon as you choose.
bg_amazonNeedsProtectionPlanChoice.description: On-page toast while waiting on a protection-plan upsell choice. $1 is a shortened item title.

bg_addToListDropdownNotFound.message: Add-to-List dropdown not found on this page.
bg_addToListDropdownNotFound.description: Error when Amazon's native Add-to-List split-button dropdown can't be located on a product page.

bg_createEntryNotFound.message: Create-a-List entry not found in the chooser.
bg_createEntryNotFound.description: Error when the 'create a new list' entry can't be found in Amazon's Add-to-List dropdown.

bg_createListFormDidNotAppear.description: Error when Amazon's create-list modal doesn't render after being triggered.

bg_createButtonNotFound.message: Create button not found in the create-list form.
bg_createButtonNotFound.description: Error when the Create submit button can't be found in Amazon's create-list modal.

bg_noConfirmationAfterCreate.description: Error when Amazon gives no visible confirmation after submitting the create-list form.

bg_noResultFromCreateList.description: Internal fallback error when the create-list page script produces no result at all.

bg_listNotFoundInMenu.message: List __LISTID__ not found in the Add-to-List menu.
bg_listNotFoundInMenu.description: Error when a specific list id isn't found among the rows in Amazon's Add-to-List dropdown. IMPORTANT: keep the literal token "__LISTID__" exactly as written — it is replaced with the actual list id by code via string.replace, not by chrome.i18n's own $NAME$ placeholder system (avoid $..$ tokens here, they collide with Chrome's manifest-load validation).

bg_noResult.description: Internal fallback error when a page script produces no result at all.

bg_bulkIncomplete_title.description: Title of the on-page prompt shown when Amazon's bulk-add endpoint only partially (or not at all) added the requested items.

bg_bulkIncomplete_stillMissing.description: Section header + list appended to the bulk-incomplete prompt body. $1 is a newline-separated bullet list of missing item names (already formatted, may contain the literal bullet character •).

bg_bulkIncomplete_andNMore.description: Truncation line appended to the missing-items list when there are more than the display cap. $1 is a plain number. Rendered after a bullet character the caller prepends.

bg_bulkIncomplete_summaryPartial.message:
Bulk add only got $1 of $2 items into your cart.

Would you like to restore the remaining $3 one at a time? This is slower but more reliable.
bg_bulkIncomplete_summaryPartial.description: Body of the bulk-incomplete prompt when some items landed. $1 added count, $2 total count, $3 missing count (all plain numbers).

bg_bulkIncomplete_summaryNone.message:
The bulk add didn't put any items in your cart — Amazon's batch endpoint may have silently dropped them (often because the associate tag isn't recognized).

Would you like to restore all $1 items one at a time instead?
bg_bulkIncomplete_summaryNone.description: Body of the bulk-incomplete prompt when nothing landed. $1 is a plain number (total item count).

bg_bulkIncomplete_choiceManual.description: Choice button on the bulk-incomplete prompt, offered when the confirm page is still open.

bg_bulkIncomplete_choiceFallback.description: Choice button on the bulk-incomplete prompt, triggers the slower per-item restore engine.

bg_bulkIncomplete_choiceSkip.description: Choice button on the bulk-incomplete prompt, abandons the missing items.

bg_savingCart.description: Operation-status title while saving the live Amazon cart to a new list.

bg_savingItemsToNewList.message: Saving $1 to a new Amazon list…
bg_savingItemsToNewList.description: Operation-status detail while saving the live cart. $1 is an already-formatted 'N item(s)' phrase.

bg_addingToList.description: Operation-status title while adding a single item to a specific Amazon list. $1 is the list name.

bg_openingProductPage.description: Operation-status detail while navigating to a product page to add it to a list.

bg_addToListFailed.description: Fallback error when adding an item to an Amazon list fails without a more specific reason.

bg_creatingList.description: Operation-status title while creating a new Amazon list seeded with one item. $1 is the list name.

bg_settingUpYourList.description: Operation-status detail while a new Amazon list is being created.

bg_cartAppearsEmpty.message: Cart appears empty — nothing to save.
bg_cartAppearsEmpty.description: Error when trying to save a cart that has no items (legacy local-cart path).

bg_amazonCartLooksEmpty.message: Your Amazon cart looks empty — nothing to save.
bg_amazonCartLooksEmpty.description: Error when trying to save the live Amazon cart and it appears empty.

bg_missingListIdOrAsin.description: Validation error when a required list id or product id is missing from a request.

bg_missingAsin.description: Validation error when a required product id is missing from a request.

bg_missingListId.description: Validation error when a required list id is missing from a request.

bg_paymentServiceNotAvailable.description: Error when the checkout/payment integration isn't ready.

bg_couldntOpenCheckout.description: Error when opening the payment checkout page fails.

bg_purchasesHandledInApp.message: Purchases are handled in the Styx Multi-Cart app.
bg_purchasesHandledInApp.description: Error shown on Safari when a purchase flow is attempted through the extension instead of the native host app.

bg_noAvailableItemsOnWishlist.message: No available items were found on this wishlist.
bg_noAvailableItemsOnWishlist.description: Error when a wishlist has no items eligible to add to the cart.

bg_cartLimitReachedUpgrade.message: Cart limit reached — upgrade to add more.
bg_cartLimitReachedUpgrade.description: Error when a free-tier user tries to create a cart beyond their limit.

bg_noResultPeriod.description: Generic internal fallback error when an operation produces no result at all.

bg_promoCodeInvalid.description: Error when a redeemed promo code doesn't match any known valid code.

bg_promoCodeAlreadyUsed.message: This code has already been used on this device.
bg_promoCodeAlreadyUsed.description: Error when a promo code was already redeemed on this device.

bg_firstError.description: Diagnostic summary prefix showing the first failure reason when a batch operation adds nothing. $1 is a lower-level error message.

bg_nothingWasAdded.description: Diagnostic summary when a batch operation adds nothing and no specific failure was recorded.

bg_cartHasNoItemsToSave.message: This cart has no items to save.
bg_cartHasNoItemsToSave.description: Error when trying to save a cart that has no items.

bg_savingLabelToAmazon.description: Operation-status title while a cart is being saved/synced to its Amazon list. $1 is the cart's quoted name or a generic fallback word.

bg_atcButtonNotFoundFull.message: Add to Cart button not found or not visible
bg_atcButtonNotFoundFull.description: Error recorded when a product's Add to Cart button can't be located on the page at all.

bg_atcButtonStayedDisabled.message: Add to Cart button stayed disabled
bg_atcButtonStayedDisabled.description: Error recorded when a product's Add to Cart button is found but never becomes clickable.

promo_tagline1.description: First line of the Chrome Web Store promo tile tagline (also used as the on-page render's headline).

promo_tagline2.description: Second line of the Chrome Web Store promo tile tagline.

promo_subtext.description: Small subtext line on the Chrome Web Store promo tiles. Keep the middle-dot separator.

popup_op_saving.description: Label on the Save Amazon cart for later button while a save is running. Keep it short: the button is narrow and does not wrap.

popup_op_clearing.description: Label on the Clear Amazon cart button while the cart is being emptied. Keep it short: the button is narrow and does not wrap.

popup_op_working.description: Fallback title of the in-panel progress banner when an operation is running but has not reported a step yet.

popup_op_wait.message: Please wait for this to finish before starting another action.
popup_op_wait.description: Small hint under the progress banner explaining why the panel's buttons are disabled until the operation finishes.

bg_alreadyRunning.message: Another Styx action is still running. Please wait for it to finish.
bg_alreadyRunning.description: Error shown when the user starts an action while another Styx action is still running.

popup_action_save.description: Confirm button label for saving (used by the name-your-cart prompt).

popup_prompt_saveForLater_title.description: Title of the prompt that asks the user to name the new cart before Save Amazon cart for later runs.

popup_prompt_saveForLater_message.message: Saves everything in your Amazon cart as a new cart. Your Amazon cart stays as it is.
popup_prompt_saveForLater_message.description: Explains under the prompt title that saving copies the Amazon cart into a new cart and leaves the Amazon cart untouched.
